36692-the-whole-armour-of-god.description: A book by J. H. Jowett, D.D.. _Eternal God, may no distraction draw us away from our communion with Thee. May we come to Thee like children going home, jubilant and glad. We have been in the far country and our garments are stained. May we hasten to the ministry of forgiveness and reconciliation.

72770-the-plums-of-new-york.title: Plums Of New York
72770-the-plums-of-new-york.creator: Unknown
72770-the-plums-of-new-york.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The great genus Prunus includes plums, cherries, almonds, apricots, peaches, and the evergreen cherries or cherry laurels. Its widely distributed species number a hundred or more for the world, nearly all of which belong north of the equator. The species of the genus are widely distributed in both the eastern and western hemispheres, the flora of eastern America and of western Asia being especially rich in species and individuals.

arxiv-2109-00734.title: Ramsey Numbers of Trails
arxiv-2109-00734.creator: Masatoshi Osumi
arxiv-2109-00734.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Masatoshi Osumi. We initiate the study of Ramsey numbers of trails. Let k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 be a positive integer. The Ramsey number of trails with k k vertices is defined as the the smallest number n n such that for every graph H H with n n vertices, H H or the complete H ¯ \overline{H} contains a trail with k k vertices.

arxiv-2112-09845.title: Time-Aware Neighbor Sampling for Temporal Graph Networks
arxiv-2112-09845.creator: Yiwei Wang Yujun Cai Yuxuan Liang Henghui Ding, Changhu Wang Bryan Hooi
arxiv-2112-09845.description: Abstract We present a new neighbor sampling method on temporal graphs. In a temporal graph, predicting different nodes’ time-varying properties can require the receptive neighborhood of various temporal scales. In this work, we propose the TNS ( Time-aware Neighbor Sampling ) method: TNS learns from temporal information to provide an adaptive receptive neighborhood for every node at any time.

arxiv-2301-01047.title: A Theory of Human-Like Few-Shot Learning
arxiv-2301-01047.creator: Zhiying Jiang, Rui Wang, Dongbo Bu, Ming Li
arxiv-2301-01047.description: Abstract We aim to bridge the gap between our common-sense few-sample human learning and large-data machine learning. We derive a theory of human-like few-shot learning from von-Neuman-Landauer’s principle. Modelling human learning is difficult as how people learn varies from one to another.

arxiv-2408-10366.title: Yang-Mills extension of the Loop Quantum Gravity-corrected Maxwell equations
arxiv-2408-10366.creator: G. L. L. W. Levy, J. A. Helayël-Neto
arxiv-2408-10366.description: Abstract In this paper, we endeavour to build up a non-Abelian formulation to describe the self-interactions of massless vector bosons in the context of Loop Quantum Gravity (LQG). To accomplish this task, we start off from the modified Maxwell equations with the inclusion of LQG corrections and its corresponding local U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) gauge invariance.

arxiv-2509-24167.title: Exploring Opportunities to Support Novice Visual Artists’ Inspiration and Ideation with Generative AI
arxiv-2509-24167.creator: Cindy Peng *, Alice Qian *, Linghao Jin, Jieneng Chen, Evans Xu Han, Paul Pu Liang, Hong Shen, Haiyi Zhu, Jane Hsieh
arxiv-2509-24167.description: Abstract . Recent generative AI advances present new possibilities for supporting visual art creation, but how such promise might assist novice artists during early-stage processes requires investigation. How novices adopt or resist these tools can shift the relationship between the art community and generative systems.

plos-pone-0003072.title: Overexpression of Partner of Numb Induces Asymmetric Distribution of the PI4P 5-Kinase Skittles in Mitotic Sensory Organ Precursor Cells in Drosophila
plos-pone-0003072.creator: Carolina N. L. R. Perdigoto, Louis Gervais, Erin Overstreet et al.
plos-pone-0003072.description: PLOS ONE research article. Unequal segregation of cell fate determinants at mitosis is a conserved mechanism whereby cell fate diversity can be generated during development. In Drosophila , each sensory organ precursor cell (SOP) divides asymmetrically to produce an anterior pIIb and a posterior pIIa cell.

pmc-10695482.title: Impact of Supine Versus Semirecumbent Body Posture on the Distribution of Ventilation in Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome
pmc-10695482.creator: Alex K. Pearce, W. Cameron McGuire, Ann R. Elliott, Ewan C. Goligher, G. Kim Prisk, James P. Butler, Atul Malhotra
pmc-10695482.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In some patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), a paradoxical improvement in respiratory system compliance (CRS) has been observed when assuming a supine (head of bed [HOB] 0°) compared with semirecumbent (HOB 35–40°) posture. We sought to test the hypothesis that mechanically ventilated patients with ARDS would have improved CRS, due to changes in ventilation distribution, when moving from the semirecumbent to supine position. We conducted a prospective, observational ICU study including 14 mechanically ventilated patients with ARDS.

pmc-10710561.title: 10015-NI-1 PREDICTION OF MGMT PROMOTOR METHYLATION STATUS IN GLIOBLASTOMA BY CONTRAST-ENHANCED T1-WEIGHTED IMAGE
pmc-10710561.creator: Takahiro Sanada, Manabu Kinoshita, Takahiro Sasaki, Shota Yamamoto, Seiya Fujikawa, Shusei Fukuyama, Nobuhide Hayashi, Junya Fukai, Noriko Okita, Masahiro Nonaka, Takehiro Uda, Hideyuki Arita, Kanji Mori, Kenichi Ishibashi, Koji Takano, Namiko Nishida, Tomoko Shofuda, Ema Yoshioka, Daisuke Kanematsu
pmc-10710561.description: PURPOSEThe study aims to explore MRI phenotypes that predict the methylation status of the promoter region of MGMT (pMGMT) in glioblastoma. MATERIALS AND METHODS202 histologically and molecularly confirmed glioblastoma patients (pMGMT methylated: 103, unmethylated: 99) at the Kansai Network for Molecular Diagnosis of Central Nervous Tumors (KNBTG) were used as a test cohort.

pmc-10739991.title: Chromatically Corrected Multicolor Multiphoton Microscopy
pmc-10739991.creator: Hugo Blanc, Gabriel Kaddour, Nicolas B David, Willy Supatto, Jean Livet, Emmanuel Beaurepaire, Pierre Mahou
pmc-10739991.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Simultaneous imaging of multiple labels in tissues is key to studying complex biological processes. Although strategies for color multiphoton excitation have been established, chromatic aberration remains a major problem when multiple excitation wavelengths are used in a scanning microscope. Chromatic aberration introduces a spatial shift between the foci of beams of different wavelengths that varies across the field of view, severely degrading the performance of color imaging.

pmc-11591543.title: Supporting Young Children’s Self-Regulation Through Nature-Based Practices in Preschool
pmc-11591543.creator: Julie Ernst, Hannah Stelley, Alan Ewert, Alison Voight
pmc-11591543.description: Self-regulation is a crucial skill in early childhood, due to its influence on school readiness and success, as well as its foundational role in promoting wellbeing across the lifespan. Additionally, self-regulation is malleable, particularly during early childhood. This study investigated the impact of nature-based practices on preschoolers’ self-regulation.

pmc-11634037.title: CENP-C-targeted PLK-1 regulates kinetochore function in C. elegans embryos
pmc-11634037.creator: Laura Bel Borja, Samuel J. P. Taylor, Flavie Soubigou, Federico Pelisch
pmc-11634037.description: Polo-like kinase 1 (PLK-1) is present in centrosomes, the nuclear envelope and kinetochores and plays a significant role in meiosis and mitosis. PLK-1 depletion or inhibition has severe consequences for spindle assembly, spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC) activation, chromosome segregation and cytokinesis.

pmc-12560430.title: Trend dynamics of mumps prevalence among children aged 1–9 years in Changzhou, 2005–2023: a joinpoint regression and age-period-cohort analysis
pmc-12560430.creator: Dan Wu, Changlei Han, Suting Xiong, Shufan Wu, Peipei Zhang, Han Gao, Cheng Tian, Junhong Li, Xin Dong, Xufeng Lv, Qinwen Xu
pmc-12560430.description: BackgroundDespite the inclusion of one dose of measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination in the Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI), mumps cases and outbreaks continue to occur. The objective of this study is to explore the epidemiologic pattern of mumps in Changzhou from 2005 to 2023 and to predict the future trend of mumps.

pmc-12626882.title: RNA m6A regulates the transcription and heterochromatin state of retrotransposons in Arabidopsis
pmc-12626882.creator: Peizhe Song, Zhihe Cai, Subiding Tayier, Enlin Tian, Zixin Chen, Kemiao Yu, Lixiang Liu, Guifang Jia
pmc-12626882.description: Chromatin and transcription states are crucial for establishing and maintaining gene regulation and genome integrity, governed by a complex network of epigenetic modifications. Despite significant advancements, the interplay between epitranscriptomic and epigenetic modifications in transcriptional regulation and chromatin state remains elusive in plants. Here we profile a comprehensive spectrum of N6-methyladenosine (m6A) on chromatin-associated RNAs, especially retrotransposon transcripts, in Arabidopsis.

pmc-12634539.title: Global research dynamics in the Tai Chi and insomnia: a bibliometric study from 2006 to 2025
pmc-12634539.creator: Mo Liao
pmc-12634539.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveTai Chi has demonstrated beneficial effects in managing insomnia. However, no bibliometric analysis has systematically examined the relationship between Tai Chi and insomnia. This study aims to quantitatively evaluate the global research landscape and emerging trends related to “Tai Chi and insomnia” from 2006 to 2025 using bibliometric methods, thereby offering evidence-based insights and guidance for future basic and clinical research.MethodsA bibliometric analysis was conducted using data retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection (WoSCC)) and Scopus databases for the period

pmc-12717706.title: Associations of parenting stress with coping strategies, dental fear, and behaviour during dental treatment in school-aged children: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12717706.creator: Baranya Shrikrishna Suprabha, Harshitha Sharma, Ramya Shenoy, Arathi Rao, Kunnumal Thekkeveetil Shwetha, Raghbir Kaur
pmc-12717706.description: BackgroundParenting stress can affect coping strategies and behaviour problems among children in nondental settings.ObjectiveTo evaluate the associations of parenting stress with children’s coping strategies, dental fear, and behaviour during dental treatment in school-aged children.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included n = 168 children aged 8–12 years who required dental treatment under local anaesthesia.

pmc-13002249.title: The Relationship Between Peripheral Eosinophilia, Lower Respiratory Tract Pathogens, Age at First Pneumonia, and Malnutrition in Children with Non-cystic Fibrosis Bronchiectasis
pmc-13002249.creator: Esin Gizem Olgun, Gizem Özcan, Fazılcan Zirek, Merve Nur Tekin, Secahattin Bayav, Mahmut Turğut, Mukaddes Ağırtıcı, Semra Küçük Öztürk, Seyhan Çelik Merteşe, Nazan Çobanoğlu
pmc-13002249.description: OBJECTIVENon-cystic fibrosis (non-CF) bronchiectasis is a chronic lung disease, primarily characterised by neutrophilic inflammation, with Haemophilus influenzae (HI) frequently isolated from respiratory cultures. Recent adult studies have suggested a potential role for eosinophils in the frequency of pulmonary exacerbations and in lung function decline.

pmc-13185654.title: Negotiating research in the Emergency Department: a qualitative study of staff experience of the Distal Radius Acute Fracture Trial CAst versus SPlint (DRAFT3-CASP) RCT for distal radius fractures
pmc-13185654.creator: Emma E Phelps, Elizabeth Tutton, Jenny Gould, Liz Baird, Juul Achten, Matthew L Costa
pmc-13185654.description: AimsWe sought to explore staff experience of conducting an orthopaedic trauma randomized controlled trial (RCT) in the Emergency Department (ED). The Distal Radius Acute Fracture Trial: CAst versus SPlint (DRAFT3-CASP) RCT explores the effectiveness of two treatment pathways for patients with a fracture of the distal radius that does not require manipulation.

pmc-13264319.title: DDERMMAL, a melanocytic long non-coding RNA, confers DNA damage tolerance to melanoma cells
pmc-13264319.creator: Sara Adnane, Yvessa Verheyden, Alessandro Cuomo, Tiziana Bonaldi, Eleonora Leucci
pmc-13264319.description: SummaryDespite remarkable advances in targeted therapies and immunotherapies, a subset of patients fails to respond due to intrinsic resistance, and the majority of those who initially benefit eventually relapse. The emergence of resistant clones under therapeutic pressure has been attributed to both genetic and/or non-genetic resistance mechanisms.

pmc-13350364.title: Carotid stiffness quantified through shear wave elastography and pulse wave velocity by ultrafast ultrasound for assessing cardiovascular risk
pmc-13350364.creator: Xuehui Ma, Zhengqiu Zhu, Yinping Wang, Bixiao Shen, Xuezhong Jiang, Chong Zou, Hui Gao, Ping Dai, Hui Huang
pmc-13350364.description: BackgroundCarotid arterial stiffness is closely linked to cardiovascular (CV) events. Traditional evaluation methods have limitations in detecting early vascular lesions and do not adequately capture regional elastic changes. Real-time shear wave elastography (RT-SWE) can quantify local carotid stiffness, while ultrafast pulse wave velocity (ufPWV) provides regional stiffness assessment.
